dz: 美国革命:斯普林菲尔德战役(英语:Battle of Springfield)在新泽西州斯普林菲尔德及其周围(包括了Short Hills,前身是斯普林菲尔德,现为米尔本镇)进行战斗.
de: American Revolution: Battle of Springfield fought in and around Springfield, New Jersey (including Short Hills, formerly of Springfield, now of Millburn Township).

t: 兰德舒特战役:奥地利击败普鲁士.
te: Battle of Landeshut: Austria defeats Prussia.
dz: 七年战争:兰德舒特战役:奥地利击败普鲁士.
de: Seven Years' War: Battle of Landeshut: Austria defeats Prussia.

t: 克雷菲尔德战役：英国、汉诺威和普鲁士军队在德国克雷菲尔德击败法国军队。
te: Battle of Krefeld: British, Hanoverian, and Prussian forces defeat French troops at Krefeld in Germany.
dz: 七年战争：克雷菲尔德战役：英国、汉诺威和普鲁士军队在德国克雷菲尔德击败法国军队。
de: Seven Years' War: Battle of Krefeld: British, Hanoverian, and Prussian forces defeat French troops at Krefeld in Germany.

t: 罗伯特·克莱夫 (Robert Clive) 领导下的三千名英国军队在普拉西 (Plassey…
te: Three thousand British troops under Robert Clive defeat a 50,000-strong Indian army under Siraj ud-Daulah at Plassey.
dz: 普拉西战役：罗伯特·克莱夫 (Robert Clive) 领导下的三千名英国军队在普拉西 (Plassey) 击败了西拉吉·乌德·道拉 (Siraj ud-Daulah) 领导下的 50,000 名印度军队。
de: Battle of Plassey: Three thousand British troops under Robert Clive defeat a 50,000-strong Indian army under Siraj ud-Daulah at Plassey.

t: 阿卡迪亚的法国居民被给予一年的时间宣布效忠英国或离开加拿大新斯科舍.
te: The French residents of Acadia are given one year to declare allegiance to Britain or leave Nova Scotia, Canada.
dz: 阿卡迪亚的法国居民被给予一年的时间宣布效忠英国或离开加拿大新斯科舍.
de: The French residents of Acadia are given one year to declare allegiance to Britain or leave Nova Scotia, Canada.

t: 威廉·彭与宾夕法尼亚州的莱纳佩印第安人签订友好条约.
te: William Penn signs a friendship treaty with Lenape Indians in Pennsylvania.
dz: 威廉·彭与宾夕法尼亚州的莱纳佩印第安人签订友好条约.
de: William Penn signs a friendship treaty with Lenape Indians in Pennsylvania.

t: (原始内容存档于2013-10-12). The Action of Faial, Azore…
te: The Action of Faial, Azores. The Portuguese carrack Cinco Chagas, loaded with slaves and treasure, is attacked and sunk…
dz: (原始内容存档于2013-10-12). The Action of Faial, Azores. 装有奴隶和宝藏的葡萄牙卡拉克Cinco Cagas被英国船只攻击并被击沉,船上700多人中只有13名幸存者.
de: The Action of Faial, Azores. The Portuguese carrack Cinco Chagas, loaded with slaves and treasure, is attacked and sunk by English ships with only 13 survivors out of over 700 on board.

t: 奥斯曼海军司令德拉古特在马耳他大围攻中战死.
te: Dragut, commander of the Ottoman navy, dies during the Great Siege of Malta.
dz: 奥斯曼海军司令德拉古特在马耳他大围攻中战死.
de: Dragut, commander of the Ottoman navy, dies during the Great Siege of Malta.

t: 英国亨利八世与法国弗朗索瓦一世签署《法国更亲和条约》（又称波美拉耶条约），承诺互助对抗神圣罗马…
te: Henry VIII of England and Francis I of France sign the "Treaty of Closer Amity With France" (also known as the Pommeray…
dz: 英国亨利八世与法国弗朗索瓦一世签署《法国更亲和条约》（又称波美拉耶条约），承诺互助对抗神圣罗马帝国皇帝查理五世。
de: Henry VIII of England and Francis I of France sign the "Treaty of Closer Amity With France" (also known as the Pommeraye treaty), pledging mutual aid against Charles V, Holy Roman Emperor.

t: 班诺克本战役(斯德林以南)开始.
te: The Battle of Bannockburn (south of Stirling) begins.
dz: 第一次苏格兰独立战争:班诺克本战役(斯德林以南)开始.
de: First War of Scottish Independence: The Battle of Bannockburn (south of Stirling) begins.

t: 弗拉芒人和法国人在奥尔日河畔阿斯签订和平条约.
te: A peace treaty between the Flemish and the French is signed at Athis-sur-Orge.
dz: 弗拉芒人和法国人在奥尔日河畔阿斯签订和平条约.
de: A peace treaty between the Flemish and the French is signed at Athis-sur-Orge.

t: 劳里亚的罗杰手下的阿拉贡斯分舰队在靠近那不勒斯的伯爵之战中击败了一支安热文分舰队.
te: The Aragonese fleet under Roger of Lauria defeats a Angevin fleet in the Battle of the Counts close to Naples.
dz: 劳里亚的罗杰手下的阿拉贡斯分舰队在靠近那不勒斯的伯爵之战中击败了一支安热文分舰队.
de: The Aragonese fleet under Roger of Lauria defeats a Angevin fleet in the Battle of the Counts close to Naples.

t: 在格拉纳达酋长国摩克林之战中伏击了一支上级追击部队,在为卡斯蒂利亚王国所发动的军事灾难中杀死了…
te: In the Battle of Moclín the Emirate of Granada ambush a superior pursuing force, killing most of them in a military dis…
dz: 西班牙人Reconquista:在格拉纳达酋长国摩克林之战中伏击了一支上级追击部队,在为卡斯蒂利亚王国所发动的军事灾难中杀死了大部分人.
de: The Spanish Reconquista: In the Battle of Moclín the Emirate of Granada ambush a superior pursuing force, killing most of them in a military disaster for the Kingdom of Castile.

t: 在特拉帕尼战役中,威尼斯人击败了一支更大的热那亚分舰队,俘虏了它的所有舰只.
te: In the Battle of Trapani, the Venetians defeat a larger Genoese fleet, capturing all its ships.
dz: 圣萨巴斯之战: 在特拉帕尼战役中,威尼斯人击败了一支更大的热那亚分舰队,俘虏了它的所有舰只.
de: War of Saint Sabas: In the Battle of Trapani, the Venetians defeat a larger Genoese fleet, capturing all its ships.

t: 孙权称帝，东吴。
te: Sun Quan proclaims himself emperor of Eastern Wu.
dz: 孙权称帝，东吴。
de: Sun Quan proclaims himself emperor of Eastern Wu.
